Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Note: Only designer recommended vendors are eligible to participate in the tender. 1.(a) The LUG-500 is to be manufactured and Supplied by the vendor as per enclosed documents. (b)The LUG-500 to be manufacture as per following documents, i) Quality Assurance Plan and QT/AT docu ment for LUG 500, Doc No: DRDL/DOFS/SD/HELINA-036/1170, REV: Nill, Date of Issue: 10/11/2016 and DRG NO.:- 7300 3400 00 00 03 B. ii) Letter of Technical Approval, LoTA Ref No: RCMA (AA)/2023/LoTA No. 03 (c)The required input material /Raw material is under vendor scope. Vendor should carry out all the raw m aterial testing's as per document. (d) Component level Testing should be carried out as per QAP & QT/AT d ocument, which is under vendor scope. The Quantities consumed for Testing are under vendor scope. (e) Inspection / test facility: No inspection / test facility will be provided by BDL. All the fixtures, Jigs, tools & Equipment necessary for Fabrication/Inspection/Testing/ is under vendor scope. (f) Quantities ordered shall be Qualified (Usable) and Deliverable units. 2. All the components should be fre e from burrs, damages, etc. 3. Inspection agency: (a) Inspection agency is MSQAA and/or their nominated inspection agency. (b) All the supplies should accompany with all the relevant inspection/test reports of the items cleared by t he inspection agency. (c) Inspection will be carried out at manufacturer's/Vendor's place. (d)Vendor shall i nform BDL and MSQAA at various stages as per QA Matrix, prior One Week to review/witness and give clea rance for further processing. (e) The items shall be dispatched to BDL only after pre-dispatch inspection (PDI) by BDL/ Green Card of MS QAA /their nominated inspection agency (f)Final acceptance will be given after receipt of the items at BDL stores along with I-Note/Green Card of M SQAA or their nominated inspection agency 4. All documents /drawings supplied along with this tender are the property of DRDO and 100% IPR is held with DRDO. These documents/drawings shall not be used for any other purpose, not to be disclosed, copie d and revised in any form without the permission of RCI (DRDO). 5. Delivery Term: The items shall be delivered at BDL stores and free delivery to BDL (F.O.R. BDL, Kancha nbagh, Hyderabad). 6. Delivery schedule:-Total Order Quantities shall be supplied in two lots as per the following schedule; Lot Quantity Delivery Schedule Lot-1 400 T0 + 6 Months Lot-2 480 T1 + 4 Months T0 = Date of receipt of MSQAA vetted purchase order (PO). T1 = Date of Acceptance of Lot-1 Early deliveries are acceptable. 7. Replacement for the rejected items shall be provided on Priority basis at free of cost. 8. (a) The equipment used for special fabrication process like furnaces, thermocouples, pressure gauges e tc shall have valid calibration certificate. (b)All the measuring instruments/ gauges shall have valid calibration certificate and shall be produced to i nspection agency of BDL on demand.

(c) The Tools, Jigs & Fixtures, Mandrels, etc, used for fabrication are under vendor scope. 9.(a) All the Items shall be marked by engraving/labelling/ providing tag to ensure identification of compon ent/ heat cycle during and after fabrication (b)Engraving/Marking shall be done at the location marked/shown as in the drawing. For other components , don’t have engraving location, shall be tagged/labelled with their identification number. 10. Complete inspection and documentation shall be carried out and maintained by the manufacturer as p er drawings and TSQD/QAP document. 11. Packing & Forwarding: Items should be securely packed as per standard specification / guidelines/ TSQ D for severe road / rail / air / sea transport conditions and the packing charges borne by the supplier. 12. Payment terms: A) 100% Payment within 30 days after receipt & acceptance of material at BDL stores. B) GST Clause: "BDL reserves its right to release GST only after supplier's invoice/debit note is reflected in GSTR-2B/2A within the specified time limit mentioned in GST law". 13. LD Clause: Time is the essence of the P.O and delivery should be strictly insisted upon according to the delivery schedule given in the SOs/POs. In the event the supplier fails to deliver the goods / service, within the stipulated delivery period, BDL reserves the right to recover from the supplier, LD and not by way of p enalty an amount as detailed in terms and conditions. A sum of 0.5% of the price only of the stores (Includi ng duties, taxes) which the supplier has failed to deliver as aforesaid for each week of delay or part thereof , subject to a maximum of 10%. In case of extension of delivery period, increase in taxes shall not be born e by BDL, if delay is attributable to vendor. 14. Benefit of ITC Clause: (a) Benefit of Input Tax Credit should be passed on to BDL without fail. (b) Benefit of reduction in rate of G ST applicable for the supply, compared to the rate of GST as per the Contract, should be passed on to BDL without fail. (c) A Certificate duly signed by the Company Secretary/ Director/ CFO/ Managing partner/ Proprietor, as th e case may be, should be furnished along with the quotation in the following format. "Certified that the be nefit of input tax credit and /or rate reduction has been duly and commensurately passed on in terms of se ction 171 of the CGST Act." 15. The Successful bidder will be debarred / blacklisted for the future tenders f or a period as decided by BDL, if the bidder deviates from the agreed terms & conditions after the award of Purchase Order / Work Order / Service Order apart from forfeiture of your EMD. 16. Supplier shall not supply non-conforming product against specification. 17. In case of non-conformity product, supplier has to inform BDL for further disposition action (i.e.re-work, rejection etc.). 18. All statutory documents, date as required under latest Explosive Rules-2008 or latest as applicable sha ll be submitted by you (Vendor). 19. Supplier shall notify to BDL in case of suspected/detected Counterfeit parts (if any) during any stage of manufacturing for its prevention of further use and quarantine of the sam e. 20. All Other Terms & conditions are applicable as per the General / Limited Terms and conditions attached . 21. It may be noted whenever special conditions are listed above; the same supersedes the conditions men tioned in General/Limited Terms & Conditions. 22. Integrity Pact: Vendor has to submit Integrity pact agreement as per the format provided by BDL.### . 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer uploaded ATC document Click here to view the file. 3.
